UPSTREAM: HID: core: replace the collection tree pointers with indices Introduced in c53431eb696f3c64c12c00afb81048af54b61532 "HID: core: store the collections as a basic tree". Previously, the pointer to the parent collection was stored. Replace the pointers with an index-based lookup into the collections array.
